About Me

Design is how it works

I'm Ebruphiyo Oghenemarho Collins — a UI/UX Designer based in Nigeria with over 5 years of experience designing digital products that are both beautiful and purposeful. I specialise in mobile and web app design, design systems, and brand identity.

From delivery platforms serving thousands of users to gaming communities, ad-tech products, and learning management systems — I bring a research-led, systems-thinking approach to every project. My work lives where clarity meets craft.

I've partnered with founders, startups, and growing businesses to take their products from rough concepts to polished, production-ready interfaces. Every pixel has a reason.

My Process

How I approach every project

01
🔍
Discover
Understanding the problem deeply — user research, stakeholder interviews, competitive analysis, and defining what success looks like.
02
🗺️
Define
User personas, journey maps, information architecture, and a clear brief that aligns design decisions with real needs and business goals.
03
✏️
Design
Wireframes, high-fidelity screens, interactive prototypes, and a complete design system — every detail crafted to be functional and beautiful.
04
🚀
Deliver
Developer-ready Figma files, annotated specs, design tokens, and collaboration with engineers to ensure what gets built matches the design.
